Test your skills on a challenging track where every decision matters. Showcase your innovation as you race head-to-head with other competitors. This event pushes the limits of creativity and engineering, offering an exciting experience filled with competition and learning. Are you ready to take the green light and race toward glory? General Rules: Each team can have a maximum of 6 members. The students must carry valid student ID cards from their college. The car has 2 categories: Nitro and electric. A team may consist of students from different colleges. Certificates of Excellence will be awarded to the top three teams. Teams must bring fuel, batteries, etc. Nothing will be provided by the organizers. The name of your car should be clearly mentioned on it. The arena shown is just for reference. It may be different from what is shown here, but the tasks will remain the same. The organizers reserve the right to change the rules as they deem fit. The judge's decision will be the final decision. Change in rules, if any, will be highlighted on the website and notified to the registered teams on prior notice.

raw.details:
All that you need to know about Techkriti Grand Prix

Introduction:

Welcome to Techkriti Grand Prix ‘27, the ultimate RC car competition! Build your RC car from scratch, combining engineering, design, and coding expertise. It’s not just about speed—precision, control, and strategy will set you apart.

Test your skills on a challenging track where every decision matters. Showcase your innovation as you race head-to-head with other competitors. This event pushes the limits of creativity and engineering, offering an exciting experience filled with competition and learning. Are you ready to take the green light and race toward glory?

General Rules:

  • Each team can have a maximum of 6 members.
  • The students must carry valid student ID cards from their college.
  • The car has 2 categories: Nitro and electric.
  • A team may consist of students from different colleges.
  • Certificates of Excellence will be awarded to the top three teams.
  • Teams must bring fuel, batteries, etc. Nothing will be provided by the organizers.
  • The name of your car should be clearly mentioned on it.
  • The arena shown is just for reference. It may be different from what is shown here, but the tasks will remain the same.
  • The organizers reserve the right to change the rules as they deem fit.
  • The judge's decision will be the final decision.
  • Change in rules, if any, will be highlighted on the website and notified to the registered teams on prior notice.
